args.subject: Force majeure notice of 22 September: revised dates and allocation, HPO-26-00450, 00532, 00614, 00670
args.body:
Dear Li Wei,

Thank you for your notice of 22 September. We have read it and are reviewing it against the Supply Agreement; this email does not accept the claim or waive any of Halden's rights.

You said revised delivery dates would follow by 10 October. We have not yet received them. Please send, per line, a revised promise date and the quantity you can ship:

HPO-26-00450 line 10 (HR-40110, open 355)
HPO-26-00450 line 20 (HR-40120, open 445)
HPO-26-00532 line 10 (HR-40130, open 1320)
HPO-26-00532 line 20 (HR-40210, open 163)
HPO-26-00532 line 30 (HR-40210, open 144)
HPO-26-00614 line 10 (HR-40110, open 435)
HPO-26-00614 line 20 (HR-40110, open 350)
HPO-26-00614 line 30 (HR-40230, open 250)
HPO-26-00670 line 10 (HR-40120, open 400)
HPO-26-00670 line 20 (HR-40130, open 1030)

You mentioned moving part of BLDC production to Plant 1 (Longgang). Please tell us what quantity you can allocate to Halden from capacity not under the notice, by part, and the earliest date each could ship. We need HR-40110, HR-40120, HR-40130, HR-40210 and HR-40230 for our October builds, so please include anything that can ship before then.

Please also confirm any finished goods stock that was not damaged and is available to us.

We would appreciate your reply as soon as you can.

Regards,
Halden Robotics Procurement

recommendation.finding: Yunzhan's force majeure stops the drive motors and brakes, so the Tern and Porter builds are short of all five parts from October, up to the full requirement unless there is stock; $396K is at stake. A request to Yunzhan for revised promise dates and allocation is drafted and waits for approval. The 10 October date for revised dates has passed with no reply on file. The four ways through are laid out below; Yunzhan's allocation answer decides most of them. The supply check never produced a line-by-line map of the stuck orders or a build-by-build breakdown, so the PO lines in the draft come from the notice and the item record. Please check them before approving.
